oracle: photutils 2.0.2 with astropy 6.1.7, numpy 2.2.6 and scipy 1.15.3
identity: Independent, cited implementations; no Gravitas code ran: photutils.aperture.aperture_photometry (CircularAperture, CircularAnnulus), photutils.centroids.centroid_com, astropy.stats.sigma_clip, astropy.modeling.fitting.FittingWithOutlierRemoval with LinearLSQFitter and models.Planar2D.
index: https://pypi.org/simple (pip default index; no mirror, no pip.conf, no PIP_* variable)
install: python3.10 -m venv <scratchpad>/oracle180; <venv>/bin/python -m pip install --only-binary :all: numpy scipy astropy photutils (the resolved versions above); the venv is not committed and no package is
run: cd <empty scratchpad directory>; <venv>/bin/python -I tools/photometry-oracle/oracle.py tests/fixtures/photometry/oracle-inputs.json tests/fixtures/photometry/oracle-results.json; then Prettier
inputsFrom: node tools/photometry-oracle/make-inputs.mjs (detector-kernel frames of fixed seeds), then Prettier
revisions: 2: oracle.py gained the `settled` flag on the flux-weighted centroid (the window loop stops on the first window it has been in and says it did not settle); every number of revision 1 is unchanged, and the inputs are the same bytes
3: make-inputs.mjs imports Buffer and process from node: and writes with process.stdout (an ESLint finding); the inputs it writes are the same bytes

parameters.apertures: CircularAperture, methods exact and center; the aperture error from a variance plane max(e, 0) + readNoise^2 (photutils sums error^2 times the weight)
parameters.annulus: CircularAnnulus.to_mask(method=center); sigma_clip(sigma=3, maxiters=4, cenfunc=median, stdfunc=mad_std); mean, std with ddof=1
parameters.plane: FittingWithOutlierRemoval(LinearLSQFitter(), sigma_clip, niter=4, sigma=3, maxiters=1, cenfunc=median, stdfunc=mad_std) on Planar2D, coordinates relative to the aperture centre
parameters.centroid: photutils.centroids.centroid_com on a (2 half + 1) square window of the background-subtracted electrons, the window moved to the rounded centroid until it stops; Gaussian-weighted: the cutout times exp(-d^2/2 sigma^2) about the current position, to a fixed point (1e-10 pixel)

conventions: pixel (0, 0) is the centre of the first pixel; electrons are bias-subtracted ADU times the gain 1.5
references: Bradley, L. et al., photutils (Zenodo release 2.0.2)
Harris, C. R. et al. 2020, Nature 585, 357 (numpy)
Virtanen, P. et al. 2020, Nature Methods 17, 261 (scipy)
